aboutUs.title: ABOUT US
aboutUs.text_1: We are Sino Argentina Group, a foreign trade company with offices in Guangzhou, China, and Buenos Aires, Argentina. Our mission is to assist Argentine SMEs to integrate into the Chinese market.
aboutUs.text_2: We offer a comprehensive foreign trade service with the Chinese market. We are responsible for facilitating all import and export procedures in both China and Argentina, with bilingual professionals based in China, with excellent command of Chinese and Spanish.
aboutUs.text_3: If you are planning to open the Chinese market for your exports, we will carry out market research, identify potential customers, facilitate sales negotiations and verify the authenticity and seriousness of the Chinese importer.

banner.title: LEARN ABOUT THE GUIDE WE HAVE DESIGNED TO MAKE IT EASY AND SAFE FOR YOU TO EXPORT FROM CHINA

services_lading.title: SERVICES
services_lading.card_text_1: We offer a comprehensive logistics service, covering everything from cargo consolidation and customs clearance at origin, to final delivery at destination.
services_lading.card_title_2: Analysis, Negotiation and Purchasing with Suppliers in China
services_lading.card_text_2: Our team of experts conducts an exhaustive analysis of the market, identifying the manufacturers that best fit your needs.
services_lading.card_text_3: We carry out customized market studies, identify potential clients and distributors, and provide you with the necessary advice to develop a successful commercial strategy.
